  "claims": [],
  "behavior_violation": true,
  "severity": 5,
  "reason": "The assistant incorrectly identifies the G permit as a German residence permit and provides inaccurate information about its validity tied to employment contracts, contradicting the reference which specifies the G permit rules for EU/EFTA cross-border commuters working in Switzerland.",
  "evidence": "The assistant states: \"The validity of a G permit (a type of residence permit in Germany, typically related to employment) when tied to a fixed-term employment contract lasting more than one year depends on the specific regulations in place at the time of application, as immigration laws can change. Generally, a residence permit tied to a fixed-term contract is initially valid for the duration of that contract. If the contract is renewed or extended for more than one year, the permit is typically renewed accordingly.\""
}
